issues.desc: CHK-002 relatedDocs points to missing docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-proof-stop-readiness-check.md; the apparent intended source exists as docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md, so PLAN/DONE related-doc reminders will miss the lifecycle_check truth source unless corrected.

CHK-003 is framed as porting regression smokes and benchmark assertions, which is engineering assurance rather than a user-observable outcome. Tie it explicitly to the operator-visible completion signal, e.g. operators can trust metadata-only DONE-readiness behavior because the focused smokes prove harmless metadata dirt passes while source/material dirt still blocks.

CHK-002 references docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-proof-stop-readiness-check.md, but that file is not present; the apparent current truth source is docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-lifecycle-readiness-check-execution-plan.md. Fix the relatedDocs path so implementers and reviewers can verify the promised lifecycle_check localReady semantics against the right decision doc.
